findings.message: The mutable default `recipients: list[str] = []` is created once and shared across calls, so every call without `recipients` appends to the same list. Welcome emails would then go to all users from earlier calls, repeatedly sending mail to and exposing addresses of other users.
This new behaviour has no test, but the contributing rules require a test for every change in behaviour. A test calling the function twice would also have caught the shared-default bug.
